description.zh: 大佬云以 5.6 元/月的极低入门价格进入视野，是市场上少有的月付几块钱就能体验跨境加速的服务商。对于偶尔出国查阅技术文档或轻度使用的用户非常实用。
description.en: Dalao Cloud is a high-performance cross-border proxy provider. Featuring BGP Relay / Shadowsocks, 100 Mbps Shared, and full support for Netflix, 4K YouTube streaming, and AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude. Starting at ¥5.6/月.
